MicroTeX, which draws LaTeX math, from https://github.com/NanoMichael/MicroTeX at commit
0e3707f6dafebb121d98b53c64364d16fefe481d, under its MIT license in LICENSE.

Only what Jot builds is kept: the library's sources in src/ with its Qt drawing in
src/platform/qt/, and the fonts in res/ with their licenses in res/fonts/licences/. Its samples,
its other platforms' drawing, its build files and its documents are left out, and so are its
Greek and Cyrillic text data, which are GPL-3.0; math draws Greek letters from Computer Modern
without them. The code is as upstream wrote it; third_party/CMakeLists.txt
builds it.
